description: Create and manage Discord bots with multiple runtime support (Node.js, Bun, Deno, Rust). Store the bot token in the OS credential vault, scaffold runtime-specific starter files, and watch the bot's console live.
author: ellipog

cargo_toml.content:
[package]
name = "discord_bot"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"

[dependencies]
serenity = { version = "0.12", default-features = false, features = ["client", "gateway", "rustls_backend", "model"] }
tokio = { version = "1", features = ["macros", "rt-multi-thread"] }

env_example.content:
# copy to .env or let the plugin's Setup tab write it
{{userOverrides.token_env}}=

gitignore.content:
# secrets and runtime artifacts
.env
node_modules/
target/
